requirement.statement: Codument SHALL validate a track's decisions.xnl (and its recursive decisions/** source set) as part of codument validate, so XNL authoring errors are caught at creation time instead of the archive gate.

case.given: 一个 active/pending track 的 decisions.xnl 含 XNL 文本块闭合误写（如 `</description>` 代替 `</?>`）
case.then: 系统 SHALL report an error that names the file and hints the correct `</?>` closer

case.given: 一个 track 的 decisions.xnl 语法合法
case.then: 系统 SHALL pass with no decisions-related errors

case.given: 一个 track 没有 decisions.xnl 也没有 decisions/ 目录
case.then: 系统 SHALL NOT report a decisions error for that track

case.given: 一个 track 存在 decisions/**/*.xnl 递归 source set
case.then: 系统 SHALL validate the recursive set the same way codument decisions validate does

case.given: xnl-format.md 的文本块语法规则
case.then: 系统 SHALL document `</description>` 等 XML 风格闭合为错误写法，闭合永远为 `</?>`
